data_objects.name: dated_v5_feature_labels
data_objects.meaning: Identified application records with AFT v5 and PAC v5 numeric feature families and a nullable 6PD/30-named label.

variables.name: apply_date
variables.meaning: Application calendar date encoded as YYYYMMDD.

variables.name: aft_v5_f0 … aft_v5_f79
variables.meaning: Eighty indexed AFT v5 numeric features with mixed scales; explicit special-looking values such as -1 occur within the family.

variables.name: pac_v5_x0 … pac_v5_x30
variables.meaning: Thirty-one indexed PAC v5 numeric features on a mostly score-like scale.

variables.name: label_6pd_30
variables.meaning: Nullable binary 0.0/1.0 outcome whose name references a 6PD/30 definition; the underlying event definition is not included.

structure.description: Each row is one identified dated feature vector. The label is absent for a substantial subset, while feature columns remain populated.

uncertainties: The 6PD/30 event definition and indexed-feature semantics are not documented.
Special numeric values in AFT features are not explicitly identified as sentinels versus valid codes.
annotation_notes: Blank label_6pd_30 cells are missing outcomes, not class 0.
Indexed AFT and PAC columns are grouped as regular high-dimensional families.
